C0725.title: Experts Warn of 'Model Poisoning' Risks at Second Wuhan Cybersecurity Innovation Forum
C0725.summary: At the AI security sub-forum of the second Wuhan Cybersecurity Innovation Forum on April 23, 2025, multiple experts highlighted emerging AI-era threats. They pointed out that 'model poisoning' can cause models to generate massive misinformation and hallucinations by injecting small amounts of 'toxic data', and stressed the importance of conducting trustworthy AI assessments.
